Amazon seeks exceptional leaders for a strategic senior management position overseeing our data center operations. This executive role offers significant visibility within the organization and aligns with our mission of becoming the world's most customer-centric company. This leader will direct managers responsible for mission-critical data center infrastructure, manage network systems, server operations, and infrastructure maintenance, and ensure optimal availability and performance across multiple regional facilities.

Requirements include proven leadership in complex data center environments, technical expertise in enterprise-scale operations, and a track record of operational excellence. This senior leadership position is critical to our Data Center Community's success.

The ideal candidate will possess comprehensive knowledge of both data center IT infrastructure and AWS cloud platforms, with a clear understanding of their integration and interoperability. Experience demonstrating practical applications of these technologies in hybrid environments is highly valued.

If you are passionate about Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon.com data centers. This may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and supervise a team of Data Center Managers (3-9 areas and front-line managers) and 100-150 hourly associates within Regional Data Centers.
- Attainment of organizational performance goals and objectives relating to safety, security, availability, scaling, and efficiency in support of our data center operations.
- Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures.
- Accountability for meeting and exceeding operational goals.
- Strategic planning and forecasting; appraise performance; reward and discipline employees; resolve problems; and address staffing needs.
- Obsess over team learning and development, both from a technical/functional and soft skills (critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and adaptability) development perspective including mentoring and training.
- Develop, improve, and share operational best practices across the globe.
- Hiring, managing, and developing the operations management team including data center managers and data center operations technicians. Planning and executing the Infrastructure Operations component of new AWS data center buildouts, new colocation buildouts, AWS data center expansions, and colocation expansions, including the network and server rack infrastructure to facilitate the daily operations.
- Experience in successful insourcing and/or outsourcing specific tasks balancing internal skillsets with frugality.
- Continuous improvement of operational processes, procedures, methods, and tools.
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Are you customer obsessed, speak AI and cloud, and want to help customers build at unbelievable scale? As an AWS Principal Customer Solutions Manager (Principal CSM), you lead the most strategic customer engagements with enterprise-wide impact, creating sustained business value for customers. You identify and solve the most intrinsically complex business and technical problems across multiple business units, geographies, and customers. As a Principal Customer Solutions Manager, you lead the most strategic customer engagements with enterprise-wide (e.g., across business units, geographies, or partner organizations) impact, creating sustained business value for customers. You identify and solve the most intrinsically complex business and technical problems across multiple business units, geographies, and/or customers, with as simple solutions as possible. You lead and execute engagements in highly undefined and rapidly evolving environments, creating and shaping strategies where information is incomplete or conflicting, creating structure and clarity for customers, partners, executives, and internal teams. Using exceptional judgment and deep technical acumen, you drive these initiatives from ambiguity to measurable results and value realization. You bring focus and strategic technical direction across enterprise-wide initiatives and cross-organizational teams, aligning entire organizations around shared outcomes. You quantify your success through long-term business impact (revenue growth, cost optimization, operational transformation, and competitive advantage), delivering transformational outcomes that help customers realize value across entire enterprises or multiple teams/business units. You orchestrate execution across enterprise workload portfolios by aligning business and technical priorities with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring long-term value realization. You translate significantly complex technical concepts into clear recommendations and strategies that change how organizations adopt technologies at scale. You guide customers through the full lifecycle of adoption and scale, ensuring technical implementations deliver quantified business results. You apply advanced technical expertise and rapidly adopt emerging technologies, including AI, to navigate complexity, making critical decisions that keep initiatives on track and accelerate delivery. You earn customer trust as a strategic advisor through solving their most complex technical challenges, shaping business outcomes and consistently delivering insights that inform long-term technical direction and business decisions. You demonstrate exceptional communication skills across all organizational levels, including the most senior level (up to and including C-suite) external stakeholders and industry partners, independently presenting and demoing to executive audiences. Every initiative you deliver is measured not only by its immediate success but by the mechanisms and best practices it leaves behind, elevating execution maturity and value realization across external and internal communities, and raising the bar for what AWS and customers can jointly achieve.

Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Technical Customer Solutions Manager, you will:

- Lead the most strategic, enterprise-wide customer engagements, identifying and solving highly complex business and technical problems across multiple business units, geographies, or partner organizations
- Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executive stakeholders, up to and including the C-suite, shaping long-term cloud and AI strategy and influencing critical business decisions
- Orchestrate execution across large, complex workload portfolios, aligning business and technical priorities across internal and external stakeholders to ensure long-term value realization
- Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations that change how organizations adopt and scale technology
- Apply deep technical expertise, including in AI and emerging technologies, to guide customers through the full lifecycle of cloud adoption, migration, and modernization
- Architect scaling mechanisms and best practices that improve operational efficiency and reduce friction across the customer's organization, not just within a single engagement
- Develop and mentor other team members, extending your influence and best practices across teams and, in some cases, across the broader customer solutions management community
- Partner closely with Solutions Architects, Account Managers, Enterprise Support, and Professional Services teams to ensure a unified, coordinated approach to the customer's success

A day in the life
A typical day starts with checking in on the initiatives you're driving forward, whether that's an upcoming executive briefing, a migration milestone, or a workshop with the customer's engineering teams. You might spend the morning on a call with a customer stakeholder, walking through progress on a cloud transformation initiative and working through a blocker together. From there, you could be syncing with your AWS account team, Solutions Architects, or product teams to make sure everyone's aligned on what the customer needs next and who owns what. Some days you're deep in a technical discussion, helping the customer think through a migration approach or how generative AI fits into their roadmap. Other days you're pulling together a business case, prepping materials for a leadership review, or coaching a less experienced teammate through a tricky customer situation. You'll regularly have direct conversations with senior customer leaders, so a good chunk of your time goes into understanding their priorities, translating that into a plan, and making sure the plan actually gets executed. No two days look exactly the same. Given the size and complexity of the customer relationships, you'll often be pulled into solving problems that don't have an obvious playbook, and that's part of what makes the role interesting.

About the team
Our team partners with one of AWS's largest and most strategic global customers, supporting their multi-year journey to the cloud across a broad and complex technology footprint. We work at the intersection of business and technology, helping this customer realize measurable value from cloud adoption, migration, and modernization initiatives, including the responsible adoption of generative AI. You'll collaborate closely with Solutions Architects, Account Managers, and Professional Services to translate the customer's strategic priorities into executable plans, and you'll have direct exposure to senior customer stakeholders and executives. Our team culture is built on ownership, curiosity, and a bias for solving hard, ambiguous problems together. We invest heavily in each other's growth, sharing best practices and mentoring one another as the role of cloud and AI advisors continues to evolve. If you're excited about helping a world-class enterprise unlock new possibilities with AWS, we'd love to have you on the team.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
